# Volume-dispersion rotation — last-hour entropy, TQQQ / QQQ

**Development window only:** 2016-01-04 → 2023-12-29. The 2024-2026 holdout
was not loaded, inspected or used for selection.

**Verdict (short):** a dev pass at 1 bp and 5 bp. The centre holds TQQQ when
the entropy of the last hour's QQQ minute volume is below its prior-year 60th
percentile, and QQQ otherwise. Dev 1 bp: **46.85% CAGR, 70.49% max DD, 1.11
Sharpe, 1,371 fills**, versus TQQQ 36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80. At 5 bp it is
**37.11% / 73.36% / 0.95**, still above the bar on both return and drawdown.
At 10 bp it fails the return bar (25.83%). The 8-cell threshold plateau passes
in all eight cells; the 30-minute neighbour fails, so the construction is not
uniformly robust. This is a dev-only reserve, not a holdout claim.

---

## 1. Rules and decision clock

The primary object is the **dispersion of minute volume**, measured as the
Shannon entropy of the 1-minute QQQ volume shares over the closing hour:

```
p_i    = v_i / sum(v_i)                 for the 60 bars 15:00-15:59 ET
H_k    = -sum p_i log p_i / log(60)
rank_k = fraction of H_j <= H_k         for j in k-252 .. k-1
```

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Decision clock | 15:59 ET close of session `k`; target written on that bar |
| Fill | 09:30 open of session `k+1`, next-open rule of `research/bt.py` |
| TQQQ weight | 1.0 if `rank_k < 0.60`, else 0.0 |
| Defensive weight | QQQ 1.0 when TQQQ is 0.0; always fully invested |
| Rank reference | prior 252 sessions, strictly before `k`; current value excluded |
| Warm-up | first 60 sessions hold QQQ; no signal |
| Costs | 1 bp headline; 5 bp and 10 bp reported |
| Band | 2% rebalance band, harness default |
| Constraints | long only, weights >= 0, row sum <= 1 |

The entropy is a *shape* object. It does not use the volume level, volume
acceleration, price trend, realised volatility, drawdown, opening range,
closing flow, relative strength or an ML model. QQQ is the defensive asset
rather than BIL so that the book keeps full equity exposure and the equity
drift; the signal only chooses the amplification.

## 2. Headline development result

| Cost | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Sortino | Vol | TQQQ exposure | Fills | Turnover | Ending equity |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 bp | 49.40% | 69.73% | 1.15 | 1.63 | 42.9% | 58.2% | 1,371 | 12,722x | $2,466,185 |
| **1 bp** | **46.85%** | **70.49%** | **1.11** | **1.58** | **43.0%** | **58.2%** | **1,371** | **11,591x** | **$2,150,224** |
| 5 bp | 37.11% | 73.36% | 0.95 | 1.34 | 43.0% | 58.2% | 1,371 | 8,054x | $1,242,558 |
| 10 bp | 25.83% | 76.65% | 0.75 | 1.06 | 43.0% | 58.2% | 1,371 | 5,212x | $626,048 |

The task bar is 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% DD / 0.82 Sharpe. The 1 bp and 5 bp
results clear both the return and drawdown bars. The 10 bp result clears the
drawdown bar but not the return bar.

### Benchmarks (same harness)

| Asset | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Vol |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TQQQ buy & hold | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 66.5% |
| QQQ buy & hold | 18.91% | 37.30% | 0.90 | 22.0% |

The official brief bar (36.72% / 82.29% / 0.82) differs from the harness TQQQ
buy-and-hold (36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80) only by daily-close versus 1-minute
marking. The strategy is compared with the official bar in the verdict.

## 3. Activity

|---|---:|
| Fills | 1,371 |
| Signal changes (session targets) | 685 |
| TQQQ session exposure | 58.3% |
| QQQ session exposure | 41.7% |

| Turnover at 1 bp | 11,591x |
| Entries into TQQQ (approx.) | 342 |

The activity floor is met with room: 1,371 fills and 685 independent target
changes. The strategy is not flat; it is fully invested in one of the two
equity legs at every bar.

## 4. Pre-registered 8-cell plateau

Only the rank threshold varies. Window = 60 minutes, lookback = 252 sessions.

| 0.65 | 42.71% | 74.46% | 1.02 | 62.7% | 1,251 | yes |

All eight cells clear 36.72% CAGR and 82.29% DD. The centre is not a single
lucky cell: the CAGR range is 38.77-46.85%, DD range 63.44-75.30%. The
threshold is a monotone exposure dial, not a narrow event trigger.

## 5. Neighbour checks

| Variant | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Fills |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Entropy 30 min | 27.49% | 83.85% | 0.78 | 1,415 |

| Rank lookback 252 | 46.85% | 70.49% | 1.11 | 1,371 |
| Rank lookback 504 | 44.90% | 61.04% | 1.12 | 1,319 |
| Continuous ramp 0.40→0.80 | 42.30% | 69.51% | 1.05 | 2,605 |

The 45-120 minute windows are all above the bar; the 30-minute window fails
the drawdown bar (83.85%). The rank lookbacks 126/252/504 are all above the
bar. The continuous ramp also passes, with a smoother exposure profile and
more fills. The 30-minute failure is reported honestly: very short windows are
noisier and the entropy estimate is less stable.

## 6. Subperiods, yearly returns and drawdown

| Period | CAGR | Max DD |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2016-2019 | 50.33% | 28.38% |
| 2020-2021 | 93.15% | 30.91% |
| 2022-2023 | 4.46% | 65.07% |

The edge is not only a 2020-2021 artifact: 2016-2019 is 50.33% CAGR with a
28.38% drawdown. 2022-2023 is weak in CAGR (4.46%) but still positive, and its
65.07% drawdown is below TQQQ's 81.10% for 2022. The 2022 drawdown is the
honest failure mode: the strategy is still a long 3x book on many days.

| Year | Strategy | TQQQ | 
|---|---:|---:|
| 2016 | +12.27% | +19.86% |

| 2018 | +38.81% | −20.76% |
| 2019 | +101.68% | +148.23% |
| 2020 | +198.77% | +104.14% |
| 2021 | +23.29% | +81.05% |

| 2023 | +180.14% | +192.05% |

The maximum drawdown is **70.49%**, peak 2021-11-22 to trough 2022-12-28. It
beats TQQQ's 82.29% but is not a low-risk profile. 2018 and 2020 are the years
where the entropy gate adds the most; 2017, 2021 and 2023 lag a pure TQQQ
melt-up, which is the expected cost of rotating to QQQ on diffuse-volume days.

## 7. Placebo

Circular shifts of the target series preserve the exact exposure, holding
lengths and turnover structure, but destroy the alignment with returns. 300
draws, daily open-to-open approximation (the real result is the 1-minute run):

| Statistic | Value |
|---|---:|
| Real daily CAGR | 49.64% |
| Placebo mean | 28.11% |
| Placebo p95 | 42.88% |
| Placebo p99 | 49.69% |
| Placebo max | 59.16% |
| p-value (draws >= real) | **0.0133** |

The real signal is above 98.7% of the shifted nulls. This is evidence that
the alignment, not just the exposure, carries the result. It is not a
multiple-testing correction for the whole research programme.

## 8. Mechanism evidence

Forward capturable return = open of session `k+1` to open of `k+2`, i.e. the
return a target written at the close of `k` can actually earn.

| Bucket | n | Mean TQQQ | Median | Win | t |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Low entropy rank (<0.60) | 1,171 | **+32.1 bp** | +32.5 bp | 55.7% | **3.25** |
| High entropy rank (>=0.60) | 777 | +5.6 bp | +42.7 bp | 55.9% | 0.31 |
| Spread | | **+26.5 bp** | | | |

The mean is the relevant statistic for a long-only book: the high-entropy
bucket has a positive median but a near-zero mean, i.e. a heavier left tail.
The same split on QQQ is +11.4 bp versus +3.0 bp; the effect is not only a
TQQQ-vol artifact.

Signal diagnostics:

- Entropy mean 0.895, std 0.048.
- Rank mean 0.490; q10 0.080, q50 0.490, q90 0.905.
- Correlation of rank with log total session volume: **+0.453**. The entropy
  shape is related to, but not identical with, the volume level.
- Correlation of rank with the same-day QQQ return: **−0.112**. The signal is
  not a restatement of the day's direction.

## 9. Controls and decomposition

| Control | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Fills |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TQQQ buy & hold | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 1 |
| QQQ buy & hold | 18.91% | 37.30% | 0.90 | 1 |
| Constant 58.2% TQQQ / 41.8% QQQ | 31.98% | 68.41% | 0.82 | 448 |
| Volume-level gate, same design | 37.05% | 68.92% | 0.97 | 939 |

The constant mix with the same average TQQQ exposure earns 31.98%, so the
timing adds about 14.9 pp of CAGR at similar drawdown. The volume-level
control (rank of total-session volume, same threshold and assets) also passes
at 37.05%, which is a real caveat: part of the result is a generic
high-volume/low-volume rotation. The entropy shape adds about 9.8 pp of CAGR
over that control at 1 bp. The family is therefore distinct in construction
but not orthogonal to volume level.

## 10. Correlation with the nine current winners

Daily strategy returns, dev slice only.

| Winner | Correlation |
|---|---:|
| `ratio-froth` | 0.588 |
| `vol-scaled-crash-stop` | 0.784 |
| `relative-value-tqqq` | 0.824 |
| `fomc-opex-window` | 0.674 |
| `family-session-timing` | 0.674 |
| `family-short-reversal` | 0.762 |
| `family-rebalance-flow` | 0.827 |
| `family-intraday-microstructure-day` | 0.553 |
| `family-ml-microstructure` | 0.790 |

Range **0.553-0.827**, mean 0.720. The highest is `family-rebalance-flow` at
0.827, below the 0.90 kill threshold. The strategy is a long equity book most
of the time, so high correlations with other long TQQQ sleeves are expected;
the distinguishing object is the volume-dispersion clock, not a claim of
statistical independence.

## 11. Causality

A truncation test rebuilds all weights from data ending 2022-01-03 and
compares every prior weight with the full-panel build:

```
truncation at 2022-01-03, compare through 2021-12-29
prior weights unchanged = True
```

The entropy rank at session `k` uses sessions `k-252 .. k-1` only. The target
is written at 15:59 and fills at the next open. The first 60 sessions hold QQQ
because the rank is undefined, not because of a selected start date.

## 12. Kill criteria and verdict

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 bp CAGR > 36.72% | 46.85%, pass |
| 1 bp max DD < 82.29% | 70.49%, pass |
| Fills >= 100 | 1,371, pass |
| 5 bp still above bar | 37.11% / 73.36%, pass |
| Placebo p <= 0.10 | 0.0133, pass |
| 2016-2019 and 2022-2023 positive | +50.33% / +4.46%, pass |
| Max winner correlation <= 0.90 | 0.827, pass |
| Neighbours positive | 45-120 min and 126/252/504 lookback pass; 30 min fails DD |
| 10 bp above bar | 25.83%, **fail** |

**Verdict: PASS at 1 bp and 5 bp; FAIL at 10 bp on CAGR.** The result is a
genuine dev pass with a broad threshold plateau, a positive placebo, and a
plausible mechanism. It is not robust to a 30-minute entropy window and it is
cost-sensitive at 10 bp, so the reserve is best used at institutional costs
(1-5 bp), not as a high-turnover retail strategy.

## 13. Caveats

- The strategy is long TQQQ 58% of sessions. Its 70.49% drawdown is high in
  absolute terms; it is a lower-drawdown way to hold a 3x book, not a
  defensive product.
- The 2022-2023 subperiod is only +4.46% CAGR with a 65.07% drawdown.
- The volume-level control also passes, so the entropy shape is an
  improvement over volume level rather than a completely independent effect.
- The rank threshold is a selection parameter. The full 0.40-0.75 grid passes,
  but the centre 0.60 is the best cell; the honest expectation is the plateau
  average (about 42%), not the centre.
- 1-minute data starts in 2016. The sample cannot test 2000/2008.
- No 2024-2026 data was loaded. The lead owns the one-shot holdout.

$env:BT_THREADS = "1"

hypothesis_md:
# Hypothesis: volume-dispersion rotation (TQQQ / QQQ)

**Slug:** `family-vol-of-volume`
**Window:** development only, 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29, 1-minute marks.
**Bar:** TQQQ dev 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe (brief). The
panel's 1 bp TQQQ buy-and-hold is 36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80.
**Status:** pre-registered before the final `strategy.py` run. No 2024+ bar is
loaded anywhere in this directory.

## 1. Claim

Minute volume is not evenly distributed through a session. On a decisive,
trend-supporting day it clusters in a few minutes around the direction of the
move. On a diffuse, unstable day it is spread thinly across the session and
the move is more likely to be noise. The *shape* of the minute-volume
distribution therefore contains information about whether the current session's
move will persist into the next session.

The object is **dispersion / entropy of minute volume**, not the volume level
and not volume acceleration:

```
p_i = v_i / sum(v_i)          over the last 60 one-minute QQQ bars (15:00-15:59)
H   = -sum p_i log p_i / log(60)
rank_k = fraction of H in the prior 252 sessions that are <= H_k
```

A low rank means volume is more concentrated than usual: decisive
participation. A high rank means volume is more diffuse than usual: unstable
participation. The claim is:

> Low closing-hour volume entropy supports continuation of the current
> session's move; high entropy makes the next session fragile. Hold TQQQ when
> entropy rank is low, and QQQ when it is high.

QQQ, not BIL, is the defensive leg. It keeps full equity exposure and the
positive drift, while removing the 3x amplification exactly when participation
is diffuse. This is a rotation between two long equity assets, not a
volatility-target or a drawdown circuit breaker.

This is **not** a trend, volatility, drawdown, opening-range, close-flow,
relative-strength or ML signal. The only input is the dispersion of QQQ
minute volume over the closing hour, ranked against its own prior year.

## 2. Exact rules (centre)

For session `k` (a regular US session):

```
H_k     = entropy of QQQ 1-minute volume shares, 15:00-15:59 ET
rank_k  = mean( H_j <= H_k for j in k-252 .. k-1 )
target for session k+1:
    TQQQ 1.0                         if rank_k < 0.60
    QQQ  1.0                         if rank_k >= 0.60
    (first 60 sessions: QQQ, no signal)
```

- Decision clock: the 15:59 ET close of session `k`. The target is written on
  that bar and fills at the 09:30 open of `k+1`. The harness's next-open rule
  is used unchanged.
- The rank uses only sessions `k-252 .. k-1`; the current session's entropy is
  compared with, not included in, the reference set. No full-sample
  normalisation.
- Long only, weights >= 0, row sum = 1. The 2% rebalance band is the harness
  default. Headline cost 1 bp; 5 bp and 10 bp are reported.
- Idle asset is QQQ. There is no cash leg in the centre.

## 3. Pre-registered grid (8 cells)

The centre is entropy window 60 minutes and rank threshold 0.60. The grid
varies only the rank threshold, because the threshold is the only free
selection parameter. The entropy window and rank lookback are checked as
neighbours, not selected on the evaluation window.

| Cell | Window | Rank threshold |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 60 min | 0.40 |
| 2 | 60 min | 0.45 |
| 3 | 60 min | 0.50 |
| 4 | 60 min | 0.55 |
| 5 | 60 min | **0.60 (centre)** |
| 6 | 60 min | 0.65 |
| 7 | 60 min | 0.70 |
| 8 | 60 min | 0.75 |

Neighbour checks: entropy window 30/45/60/90/120 minutes; rank lookback
126/252/504 sessions; a continuous weight ramp from rank 0.40 (TQQQ 1.0) to
0.80 (TQQQ 0.0).

## 4. Falsifiers decided before the run

- 1 bp CAGR <= 36.72% or max DD >= 82.29%.
- Fewer than 100 full-window fills.
- Circular-shift placebo p-value > 0.10.
- The 5 bp result turns CAGR below the bar or DD above it.
- Sign flip in 2016-2019 or 2022-2023.
- Correlation with any current winner > 0.90.
- Neighbour windows are not all positive.

A negative result is reported as a negative result. The 10 bp result is
expected to be the weak point: 685 signal changes and two equity legs make the
strategy cost-sensitive.

"""Volume-dispersion rotation TQQQ/QQQ - `family-vol-of-volume`.

DEVELOPMENT WINDOW ONLY (2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29).  No 2024+ bar is loaded.

Primary object
--------------
The dispersion of minute volume, measured as the Shannon entropy of the
1-minute QQQ volume shares in the last 60 minutes of the session, ranked
against the prior 252 sessions.  This is a *shape / dispersion* object.  It
does not use the volume level, volume acceleration, price trend, volatility,
drawdown, opening range, close flow, ML or relative strength.

Hypothesis
----------
Participation concentrated in a few minutes (low entropy rank) is decisive,
stable participation and supports continuation of the session's move into the
next session.  Diffuse, unstable participation (high entropy rank) is fragile.
The strategy holds TQQQ for the next session when the rank is below the
pre-registered threshold, and QQQ otherwise.  QQQ, not BIL, is the defensive
leg: it keeps equity exposure and the positive drift, while cutting the 3x
amplification exactly when participation is diffuse.

Decision clock
--------------
At the 15:59 ET close of session k, use QQQ 1-minute volume from 15:00-15:59
(the last 60 bars of session k) and the prior 252 completed sessions only.
The target for session k+1 is written on the 15:59 bar and fills at the
09:30 open of session k+1.  The harness's next-open rule is unchanged.

Run:
    $env:PYTHONPATH = "C:\\Users\\27175\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\pylibs"
    python research/new/family-vol-of-volume/strategy.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "research"))
import bt  # noqa: E402

DEV_START = "2016-01-04"
DEV_END = "2023-12-29"
BARS_1M = 252 * 390
SYMBOLS = ("QQQ", "TQQQ", "BIL")
COL_Q, COL_T, COL_B = 0, 1, 2

# Pre-registered centre.
RANK_THRESHOLD = 0.60
ENTROPY_MINUTES = 60
RANK_SESSIONS = 252
DEFENSIVE = "QQQ"

BAR = {"cagr": 0.3672, "max_drawdown": 0.8229, "sharpe": 0.82}
WINNERS = [
    "ratio-froth",
    "vol-scaled-crash-stop",
    "relative-value-tqqq",
    "fomc-opex-window",
    "family-session-timing",
    "family-short-reversal",
    "family-rebalance-flow",
    "family-intraday-microstructure-day",
    "family-ml-microstructure",
]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# data and signal
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def load_volume(ts) -> np.ndarray:
    """QQQ 1-minute volume aligned to the panel's regular-session bars."""
    q = pd.read_parquet(bt.DATA_DIR / "QQQ-1m.parquet")
    q["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(q["ts"], utc=True).dt.tz_convert("America/New_York")
    q = q[
        (q["ts"].dt.time >= pd.Timestamp("09:30").time())
        & (q["ts"].dt.time < pd.Timestamp("16:00").time())
    ].set_index("ts")
    return q["volume"].reindex(ts).to_numpy(dtype=float)


def volume_matrix(ts, volume: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """(sessions, width) matrix of regular-session minute volume; NaN padding."""
    _, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    nd = len(first)
    width = int((last - first + 1).max())
    mat = np.full((nd, width), np.nan)
    for k in range(nd):
        a, b = int(first[k]), int(last[k])
        mat[k, : b - a + 1] = volume[a : b + 1]
    return mat


def entropy_share(x: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """Shannon entropy of volume shares, normalised by log(length)."""
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    x = x[np.isfinite(x) & (x > 0)]
    if len(x) < 2:
        return np.nan
    p = x / x.sum()
    p = p[p > 0]
    return float(-np.sum(p * np.log(p)) / np.log(len(x)))


def entropy_series(mat: np.ndarray, minutes: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """Entropy of the last `minutes` volume bars of each session."""
    return np.array([entropy_share(mat[k, -minutes:]) for k in range(len(mat))])


def rank_prior(x: np.ndarray, sessions: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """Causal percentile rank of each value among the prior `sessions`.

    For session k the rank is the fraction of prior values <= x[k].  The
    current value is not compared with itself.  The first `min_periods`
    sessions are NaN and therefore take the defensive asset.
    """
    s = pd.Series(np.asarray(x, dtype=float))
    return s.rolling(sessions, min_periods=max(30, sessions // 4)).apply(
        lambda a: float(np.mean(a[-1] >= a[:-1])), raw=True
    ).to_numpy()


def signal_from_rank(rank: np.ndarray, threshold: float) -> np.ndarray:
    """sig[k] = target TQQQ weight for session k, set at the close of k-1."""
    sig = np.zeros(len(rank))
    good = np.isfinite(rank) & (rank < threshold)
    sig[1:] = good[:-1].astype(float)
    return sig


def build_weights_params(ts, o, c, threshold: float = RANK_THRESHOLD,
                         minutes: int = ENTROPY_MINUTES,
                         sessions: int = RANK_SESSIONS,
                         vol: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    if vol is None:
        vol = load_volume(ts)
    mat = volume_matrix(ts, vol)
    ent = entropy_series(mat, minutes)
    rank = rank_prior(ent, sessions)
    sig = signal_from_rank(rank, threshold)
    return broadcast(ts, sig)


def broadcast(ts, sig: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Map per-session targets to the (n,3) 1-minute weight matrix.

    sig is the TQQQ share; the remainder is QQQ.  On the last bar of session k
    the target for k+1 is written, so the change fills at the next open.
    """
    day_id = bt.day_ids(ts)
    _, _, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    w = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    w[:, COL_T] = sig[day_id]
    w[:, COL_Q] = 1.0 - sig[day_id]
    w[last[:-1], COL_T] = sig[1:]
    w[last[:-1], COL_Q] = 1.0 - sig[1:]
    assert w.min() >= -1e-12
    assert np.all(w.sum(axis=1) <= 1.0 + 1e-9)
    return w


def build_weights(ts, opens, closes):
    """Pre-registered centre."""
    return build_weights_params(ts, opens, closes)

def run_range(ts, o, c, w, lo=DEV_START, hi=DEV_END, bp=1.0):
    i = int(ts.searchsorted(pd.Timestamp(lo, tz="America/New_York")))
    j = int(ts.searchsorted(pd.Timestamp(hi, tz="America/New_York")
                            + pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
    return bt.simulate(ts[i:j], o[i:j], c[i:j], w[i:j], band=0.02,
                       slippage_bps=bp, start_equity=bt.START_EQUITY)


def pack(s: dict) -> dict:
    keys = ("cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "sortino", "volatility",
            "exposure", "turnover", "fills", "ending_equity", "years")
    return {k: (int(s[k]) if k == "fills" else float(s[k])) for k in keys}


def stats_block(ts, o, c, w, bp=1.0, lo=DEV_START, hi=DEV_END):
    res = run_range(ts, o, c, w, lo, hi, bp)
    return pack(bt.stats(res, BARS_1M)), res


def dd_window(ts, equity):
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(equity)
    dd = equity / peak - 1.0
    j = int(np.argmin(dd))
    i = int(np.argmax(equity[: j + 1]))
    return {"peak": str(ts[i])[:10], "trough": str(ts[j])[:10],
            "dd": float(-dd[j])}


def subperiod(ts, equity, lo, hi):
    m = ((ts >= pd.Timestamp(lo, tz="America/New_York"))
         & (ts < pd.Timestamp(hi, tz="America/New_York") + pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
    x, tt = equity[m], ts[m]
    if len(x) < 2:
        return None
    years = (tt[-1] - tt[0]).total_seconds() / (365.25 * 86400)
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(x)
    return {"cagr": float((x[-1] / x[0]) ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(x / peak - 1).min()), "years": float(years)}


def daily_approx(sig: np.ndarray, t_open: np.ndarray,
                 q_open: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """Causal daily open-to-open approximation for placebos/controls.

    sig[k] is the TQQQ share for session k set at the close of k-1.  Session
    k's capturable return is open[k+1]/open[k]-1, so use sig[:-1] against the
    return array shifted by one.
    """
    t_oo = np.r_[np.nan, t_open[1:] / t_open[:-1] - 1.0]
    q_oo = np.r_[np.nan, q_open[1:] / q_open[:-1] - 1.0]
    s = np.asarray(sig, dtype=float)[:-1]
    r = np.nan_to_num(s * t_oo[1:] + (1.0 - s) * q_oo[1:])
    eq = np.cumprod(1.0 + r)
    years = len(r) / 252.0
    return float(eq[-1] ** (1.0 / years) - 1.0)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# correlation with the nine current winners
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def archived_dev_returns(slug: str) -> pd.Series:
    d = json.loads((HERE.parent / "curves" / f"{slug}.json").read_text())
    dates = pd.to_datetime(d["dates"])
    vals = np.asarray(d["values"], dtype=float)
    keep = dates <= pd.Timestamp(DEV_END)
    return pd.Series(vals[keep], index=dates[keep]).pct_change()


def correlation_block(eqd: pd.Series, winners) -> dict:
    r = eqd.pct_change().dropna()
    out = {"winners": {}}
    for slug in winners:
        rr = archived_dev_returns(slug)
        idx = r.index.intersection(rr.dropna().index)
        out["winners"][slug] = {"corr": float(r.loc[idx].corr(rr.loc[idx])),
                                "n": int(len(idx))}
    vals = [v["corr"] for v in out["winners"].values()]
    out["min"] = float(min(vals))
    out["max"] = float(max(vals))
    out["mean"] = float(np.mean(vals))
    return out

# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def main():
    ts, o, c = bt.panel(SYMBOLS, DEV_START, DEV_END, "1min", warmup_days=30)
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    nd = len(first)
    print(f"panel {len(ts):,} bars, {nd} sessions, {ts[0].date()} .. {ts[-1].date()}")

    vol = load_volume(ts)
    mat = volume_matrix(ts, vol)
    ent = entropy_series(mat, ENTROPY_MINUTES)
    rank = rank_prior(ent, RANK_SESSIONS)
    sig = signal_from_rank(rank, RANK_THRESHOLD)
    w = broadcast(ts, sig)

    out = {
        "strategy": "family-vol-of-volume",
        "family": "vol-of-volume",
        "directory": "research/new/family-vol-of-volume",
        "window": {"start": DEV_START, "end": DEV_END, "marks": "1m",
                   "fills": "next open, 2% band", "idle": DEFENSIVE,
                   "holdout": "not loaded"},
        "rules": {
            "primary": "dispersion (entropy) of minute QQQ volume",
            "signal": ("H = -sum p_i log p_i / log(60), p_i = share of QQQ "
                       "volume in minute i over 15:00-15:59 ET"),
            "normalisation": ("causal percentile rank of H among the prior "
                              f"{RANK_SESSIONS} sessions"),
            "decision": "15:59 ET close; target for next session",
            "threshold": RANK_THRESHOLD,
            "tqqq_weight": "1.0 if rank < threshold else 0.0",
            "defensive_asset": DEFENSIVE,
            "bar": BAR,
        },
        "dev": {},
    }

    results = {}
    for bp in (0.0, 1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
        s, res = stats_block(ts, o, c, w, bp)
        results[bp] = (s, res)
        if bp in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
            out["dev"][f"{int(bp)}bp"] = s
        print(f"centre {bp:2.0f}bp  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sharpe {s['sharpe']:4.2f}  "
              f"fills {s['fills']:,}  turnover {s['turnover']:.0f}  "
              f"exposure {s['exposure']*100:.1f}%")

    s1, res1 = results[1.0]
    eq_series = bt.daily_last(res1["equity"], res1["ts"])
    eq_series.index = pd.to_datetime(eq_series.index)

    # benchmark
    i0 = bt.start_index(ts, DEV_START)
    bench = bt.benchmark(c[i0:, COL_T], ts[i0:], BARS_1M)
    out["benchmark_tqqq"] = {k: float(v) for k, v in bench.items()}
    out["benchmark_qqq"] = {k: float(v) for k, v in
                            bt.benchmark(c[i0:, COL_Q], ts[i0:], BARS_1M).items()}
    print(f"bench TQQQ  CAGR {bench['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {bench['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sharpe {bench['sharpe']:4.2f}")

    # exposure (bt.stats counts QQQ as invested; report TQQQ share separately)
    wsess = sig[1:]
    out["exposure"] = {
        "mean_tqqq_weight_session": float(np.mean(wsess)),
        "mean_tqqq_weight_bar": float(w[:, COL_T].mean()),
        "fraction_sessions_tqqq": float(np.mean(wsess > 0.99)),
        "fraction_sessions_qqq": float(np.mean(wsess < 1e-9)),
        "stats_exposure_incl_qqq": float(s1["exposure"]),
        "signal_changes": int(np.sum(np.diff(np.r_[0.0, sig]) != 0)),
    }

    bench_slice = c[i0 : i0 + len(res1["ts"]), COL_T]
    out["yearly"] = {
        str(k): {"strategy": float(v["strategy"]), "benchmark": float(v["benchmark"])}
        for k, v in bt.yearly(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], bench_slice).items()
    }
    out["dd_window"] = dd_window(res1["ts"], res1["equity"])
    out["subperiods"] = {
        "2016_2019": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2016-01-04", "2019-12-31"),
        "2020_2021": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2020-01-01", "2021-12-31"),
        "2022_2023": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2022-01-03", "2023-12-29"),
    }

    # ---- pre-registered 8-cell rank grid -----------------------------------
    grid = []
    for thr in (0.40, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.75):
        wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, threshold=thr, vol=vol)
        ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
        grid.append({"rank_threshold": thr, **ss,
                     "tqqq_exposure": float(wt[:, COL_T].mean()),
                     "passes_bar": bool(ss["cagr"] > BAR["cagr"]
                                        and ss["max_drawdown"] < BAR["max_drawdown"])})
        print(f"grid rank<{thr:.2f}  CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}  "
              f"fills {ss['fills']:,}")
    out["grid"] = grid

    # ---- neighbours: entropy window, rank lookback, continuous weight ------
    neigh = []
    for mins in (30, 45, 60, 90, 120):
        wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, minutes=mins, vol=vol)
        ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
        neigh.append({"name": f"entropy_minutes {mins}", **ss})
        print(f"neigh minutes {mins:3d}  CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")
    for sess in (126, 252, 504):
        wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, sessions=sess, vol=vol)
        ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
        neigh.append({"name": f"rank_sessions {sess}", **ss})
        print(f"neigh rank {sess:3d}     CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")
    # continuous version: weight 1 below rank 0.40, 0 at rank 0.80
    cont = np.clip((0.80 - rank) / 0.40, 0.0, 1.0)
    cont_sig = np.r_[0.0, np.nan_to_num(cont[:-1])]
    wt = broadcast(ts, cont_sig)
    ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
    neigh.append({"name": "continuous_rank_0.40_0.80", **ss,
                  "tqqq_exposure": float(np.mean(cont_sig))})
    print(f"neigh continuous      CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}  "
          f"exposure {np.mean(cont_sig):.2f}")
    out["neighbours"] = neigh

    # ---- controls ----------------------------------------------------------
    controls = {}
    wt = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    wt[:, COL_T] = 1.0
    ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["tqqq_buy_hold"] = ss
    print(f"control TQQQ          CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")
    wt = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    wt[:, COL_Q] = 1.0
    ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["qqq_buy_hold"] = ss
    print(f"control QQQ           CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")
    mean_w = float(np.mean(sig[1:]))
    wt = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    wt[:, COL_T] = mean_w
    wt[:, COL_Q] = 1.0 - mean_w
    ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["constant_mix_same_mean"] = {**ss, "tqqq_weight": mean_w}
    print(f"control constant {mean_w:.2f}  CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")

    # volume-level control: same construction on total-session QQQ volume.
    # This checks that the entropy signal is not just volume level.
    total = np.nansum(mat, axis=1)
    lvl_rank = rank_prior(total, RANK_SESSIONS)
    lvl_sig = signal_from_rank(lvl_rank, RANK_THRESHOLD)
    wt = broadcast(ts, lvl_sig)
    ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["volume_level_gate"] = {**ss, "tqqq_exposure": float(np.mean(lvl_sig[1:]))}
    print(f"control volume level  CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}  "
          f"exposure {np.mean(lvl_sig[1:]):.2f}")
    out["controls"] = controls

    # ---- event study -------------------------------------------------------
    t_open = o[first, COL_T]
    q_open = o[first, COL_Q]
    t_oo = np.r_[np.nan, t_open[1:] / t_open[:-1] - 1.0]
    q_oo = np.r_[np.nan, q_open[1:] / q_open[:-1] - 1.0]
    # forward capturable return for a decision at close k: open k+1 to
    # open k+2 = t_oo[k+2].
    fwd_t = np.r_[t_oo[2:], np.nan, np.nan]
    fwd_q = np.r_[q_oo[2:], np.nan, np.nan]
    valid = np.isfinite(rank) & np.isfinite(fwd_t)
    low = valid & (rank < RANK_THRESHOLD)
    high = valid & (rank >= RANK_THRESHOLD)
    def desc(mask, fwd):
        x = fwd[mask]
        return {"n": int(mask.sum()), "mean_bp": float(np.mean(x) * 1e4),
                "median_bp": float(np.median(x) * 1e4),
                "win": float(np.mean(x > 0)),
                "t": float(np.mean(x) / (np.std(x) / np.sqrt(len(x))))}
    ev = {
        "tqqq_low_entropy": desc(low, fwd_t),
        "tqqq_high_entropy": desc(high, fwd_t),
        "tqqq_spread_bp": desc(low, fwd_t)["mean_bp"] - desc(high, fwd_t)["mean_bp"],
        "qqq_low_entropy": desc(low, fwd_q),
        "qqq_high_entropy": desc(high, fwd_q),
    }
    out["event_study"] = ev
    print("event study", ev)

    # signal diagnostics: correlation with volume level and same-day move
    dayret = c[last, COL_Q] / o[first, COL_Q] - 1.0
    out["signal_diagnostics"] = {
        "entropy_mean": float(np.nanmean(ent)),
        "entropy_std": float(np.nanstd(ent)),
        "rank_mean": float(np.nanmean(rank)),
        "rank_q10": float(np.nanpercentile(rank, 10)),
        "rank_q50": float(np.nanpercentile(rank, 50)),
        "rank_q90": float(np.nanpercentile(rank, 90)),
        "corr_rank_log_total_volume": float(pd.Series(rank).corr(
            pd.Series(np.log(np.maximum(total, 1))))),
        "corr_rank_same_day_qqq_return": float(pd.Series(rank).corr(
            pd.Series(dayret))),
    }
    print("signal diagnostics", out["signal_diagnostics"])

    # ---- placebo -----------------------------------------------------------
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261127)
    real_daily = daily_approx(sig, t_open, q_open)
    draws = []
    for _ in range(300):
        k = int(rng.integers(30, nd - 30))
        draws.append(daily_approx(np.roll(sig, k), t_open, q_open))
    draws = np.asarray(draws)
    out["placebo"] = {
        "n_draws": int(len(draws)), "marks": "1D open-to-open approximation",
        "real_daily_cagr": float(real_daily),
        "real_1m_cagr_1bp": float(s1["cagr"]),
        "mean": float(draws.mean()), "p95": float(np.quantile(draws, 0.95)),
        "p99": float(np.quantile(draws, 0.99)), "max": float(draws.max()),
        "p_value": float((draws >= real_daily).mean()),
    }
    print("placebo", {k: (round(v, 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v)
                      for k, v in out["placebo"].items()})

    # ---- correlation vs nine winners ---------------------------------------
    corr = correlation_block(eq_series, WINNERS)
    out["corr_winners"] = corr["winners"]
    out["corr_summary"] = {"min": corr["min"], "max": corr["max"],
                           "mean": corr["mean"]}
    print("corr winners", {k: round(v["corr"], 3) for k, v in corr["winners"].items()})

    # ---- causality truncation ---------------------------------------------
    j = bt.start_index(ts, "2022-01-03")
    j2 = bt.start_index(ts, "2021-12-30")
    w_trunc = build_weights(ts[:j], o[:j], c[:j])
    out["causality"] = {
        "truncation_date": "2022-01-03",
        "compare_through": "2021-12-29",
        "prior_weights_unchanged": bool(np.allclose(w_trunc[:j2], w[:j2])),
    }
    print("causality", out["causality"])

    # ---- verdict / kill criteria ------------------------------------------
    passes = (s1["cagr"] > BAR["cagr"]
              and s1["max_drawdown"] < BAR["max_drawdown"])
    out["verdict"] = {
        "dev_pass_1bp": bool(passes),
        "cagr_margin_pp": float((s1["cagr"] - BAR["cagr"]) * 100),
        "dd_margin_pp": float((BAR["max_drawdown"] - s1["max_drawdown"]) * 100),
        "fills_floor": bool(s1["fills"] >= 100),
        "status": "PASS" if passes and s1["fills"] >= 100 else "FAIL",
    }
    out["kill_criteria"] = [
        "Kill if the 1 bp dev CAGR is at or below 36.72% or max DD at or above 82.29%.",
        "Kill if full-window fills are below 100.",
        "Kill if the circular-shift placebo p-value is above 0.10.",
        "Kill if the 5 bp result turns the CAGR below the bar or the DD above it.",
        "Kill if the sign flips in either 2016-2019 or 2022-2023.",
        "Kill if daily correlation with any current winner exceeds 0.90, which would mean the family is not distinct.",
        "Kill if the neighbour windows (entropy 30-120 min, rank lookback 126/252/504) are not all positive.",
    ]

    (HERE / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=float))
    print("wrote", HERE / "result.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
